constraints.name: domain_AppointmentSlot_2
constraints.definition: CHECK (capacity > 0 AND reserved >= 0 AND confirmed >= 0 AND (reserved + confirmed) <= capacity)

constraints.name: domain_slot_no_overlap
constraints.definition: EXCLUDE USING gist ("teacherId" WITH =, tstzrange("startsAt", "endsAt", '[)'::text) WITH &&) WHERE (state <> 'CANCELLED'::text)

constraints.name: domain_ContentRelation_2
constraints.definition: CHECK ("endsAt" IS NULL OR "startsAt" IS NULL OR "endsAt" > "startsAt")

constraints.name: domain_CouponTemplate_0
constraints.definition: CHECK ("discountValue" > 0 AND threshold >= 0 AND "totalLimit" >= "issuedCount" AND "issuedCount" >= 0 AND "perUserLimit" > 0)

constraints.name: domain_CourseCohort_1
constraints.definition: CHECK (capacity >= 0 AND reserved >= 0 AND confirmed >= 0 AND (reserved + confirmed) <= capacity)

constraints.name: domain_EventTicketType_0
constraints.definition: CHECK (capacity >= 0 AND reserved >= 0 AND confirmed >= 0 AND (reserved + confirmed) <= capacity AND "perUserLimit" > 0)

constraints.name: domain_FinanceEntry_0
constraints.definition: CHECK (debit > 0 AND credit = 0 OR credit > 0 AND debit = 0)

constraints.name: domain_LiveSession_2
constraints.definition: CHECK ("endedAt" IS NULL OR "startedAt" IS NULL OR "endedAt" >= "startedAt")

constraints.name: domain_member_no_overlap
constraints.definition: EXCLUDE USING gist ("userId" WITH =, tstzrange(("startsAt" AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'::text), ("endsAt" AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'::text), '[)'::text) WITH &&) WHERE ("revokedAt" IS NULL)

constraints.name: domain_Note_0
constraints.definition: CHECK ("rangeStart" IS NULL AND "rangeEnd" IS NULL OR "rangeStart" >= 0 AND "rangeEnd" > "rangeStart")

constraints.name: domain_PointsReward_1
constraints.definition: CHECK ("pointsCost" > 0 AND stock >= reserved AND reserved >= 0 AND "perUserDaily" > 0)

constraints.name: domain_PracticeTask_1
constraints.definition: CHECK ("endsOn" IS NULL OR "startsOn" IS NULL OR "endsOn" >= "startsOn")

constraints.name: domain_PromotionOffer_2
constraints.definition: CHECK (reserved >= 0 AND sold >= 0 AND (capacity IS NULL OR capacity >= (reserved + sold)))

constraints.name: domain_Refund_3
constraints.definition: CHECK ("requestedAmount" >= 0 AND ("approvedAmount" IS NULL OR "approvedAmount" >= 0 AND "approvedAmount" <= "requestedAmount"))

constraints.name: domain_RefundItem_1
constraints.definition: CHECK (quantity > 0 AND amount >= 0 AND "revokeQuantity" >= 0 AND "revokeQuantity" <= quantity AND "returnStockQuantity" >= 0 AND "returnStockQuantity" <= quantity)

constraints.name: domain_SaleOffer_3
constraints.definition: CHECK ("validUntil" IS NULL OR "validFrom" IS NULL OR "validUntil" > "validFrom")

constraints.name: domain_SourceEvidence_0
constraints.definition: CHECK ("validUntil" IS NULL OR "validFrom" IS NULL OR "validUntil" > "validFrom")

constraints.name: domain_TeacherReview_1
constraints.definition: CHECK (score IS NULL OR score >= 0 AND score <= 100)

constraints.name: domain_TradeOrderItem_3
constraints.definition: CHECK ("discountAllocated" >= 0 AND "shippingAllocated" >= 0 AND payable = (subtotal - "discountAllocated" + "shippingAllocated") AND payable >= 0)
